paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Pharoah kiang ah va lut in. Ama a hiai ka chiamtehnate ka etsak theihna ding in alungtang, asikhate lungtang toh ka khauhsak ahi.
heading: Khaukhupte
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, that I may show these my signs among them;

paite: Na tapa bil leh na tapa' tapa bil a, Aigupta gam a bang thil ahia ka hih, alak ua chiamtehna ka hihte na gen theih a, TOUPA ka hi chih na theihna ding un,” achi hi.
english: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son, and of your son’s son, what things I have done to Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that you may know that I am Yahweh.”

paite: Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron alut ua, akiang ah, "Hebrute TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Bang tan vei ka ma a kiniamkhiak nial lai ding na hia? Ka nna aseptheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.'
english: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, that they may serve me.

paite: Huchi ahih kei a, ka mite paisak na nialleh ngai in, na tuipiau ah zingchiang in khaukhup ka hon sawl ding hi.
english: Or else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country,

paite: Lei mai atuam ding ua, mite'n lei amu thei kei ding. Asuakta bang ane ding ua, gial in ahon hawisak teng, lou a pan nang a dia singpou chiteng ane ding uh.
english: and they shall cover the surface of the earth, so that one won’t be able to see the earth. They shall eat the residue of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.

paite: Na innte uah adim ding ua, na sikhate innte leh Aiguptate innte leh leitung om a pan tuni tan a na pate, na pate uh pate un amuh ngei louh uh," achi uhi. Huchi in akihei a, Pharaoh a pan apawtkheta hi.
english: Your houses shall be filled, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians, as neither your fathers nor your fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were on the earth to this day.’” He turned, and went out from Pharaoh.

paite: Pharaoh sikhate'n akiang ah, "Bang tan hiai mipa ei a dia thang hi ding ahia? Mite paisak mai in, TOUPA a Pathian uh nna aseptheihna ding un. Aigupta hihsiat a omta ahi, chih thei nai lou na hi hia?" achi uhi.
english: Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve Yahweh, their God. Don’t you yet know that Egypt is destroyed?”

paite: Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron ahon pi nawn ua; ama'n akiang uah, “Pai un, TOUPA na Pathian uh nna va sem un. Himahleh apai dingte kuate ahi ua?" achi hi.
english: Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh, and he said to them, “Go, serve Yahweh your God; but who are those who will go?”

paite: Mosi in, "Ka naupangte uh toh, ka tekte uh toh, ka tapate uleh ka tanute uh, ka ganhonte uleh ka belamhonte uh toh ka pai ding uhi, TOUPA kiang a ankuangluina nei ding ka hih ziak un," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “We will go with our young and with our old. We will go with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds; for we must hold a feast to Yahweh.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "TOUPA na kiang uah om hen, na numeite uh leh na nau neute uh ka hon paisakleh, en mah un, na ma uah gilou a-om hi.
english: He said to them, “Yahweh be with you if I let you go with your little ones! See, evil is clearly before your faces.

paite: Huchi hilou e, nou pasal piching teng kuan unla, TOUPA nna va sem un. Huai lah na ut ngal ua,” achi hi. Huchi in Pharaoh a pan delhkhiak in a-om uhi.
english: Not so! Go now you who are men, and serve Yahweh; for that is what you desire!” Then they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam tung ah khaukhupte ahong omna ding in na khut zankhia in. Aigupta gam a ahong paitouh ua, gam a haichi teng, gial in ahawi teng tanpha anektheihna ding un,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up on the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail has left.”

paite: Mosi in Aigupta gam tung ah achiangkhun alik a, TOUPA'Nhuai ni nitum in leh huai zankhua in suahlam huih anungsak a; zingsang ahong hih in suahlam huih in khaukhup ahon tunta hi.
english: Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt, and Yahweh brought an east wind on the land all that day, and all night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam tengteng tung ah khaukhupte a-om ua, Aigupta gam tengteng ah akhawl ua: achimtakhuai mahmah uhi. Amalam uah huchibang khaukhup a-om ngei kei a, anunglam uah leng huchibang a-om kei ding hi.
english: The locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the borders of Egypt. They were very grievous. Before them there were no such locusts as they, nor will there ever be again.

paite: Lei mai tengteng atuam ziak un, gamsung amialta hi. Gam a haichi gial in ahawite, singgahte toh ane uhi. Huchi in singte ah hiam, lou a haichite ah hiam leng thil hing a-omta kei, Aigupta gamsung teng ah.
english: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

paite: Huaitak in Pharaoh in kintak in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "TOUPA na Pathian leh noute tung ah ka na khialta hi.
english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste, and he said, “I have sinned against Yahweh your God, and against you.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in ka hon ngen ahi. Tutung kia hiai ka khelhna ngaidam inla, kei a pan hiai sihna alakmang theihna ding in, TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah ngen in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore please forgive my sin again, and pray to Yahweh your God, that he may also take away from me this death.”

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh a pan apaikheta a, TOUPA kiang ah angenta hi.
english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'n suahlam huih hat mahmah akhahta a, huai in khaukhupte alamang a, Tuipi San ah ahawllutta hi. Huchi in Aigupta gam tengteng ah khaukhup khat leng a-omta kei hi.
english: Yahweh sent an exceedingly strong west wind, which took up the locusts, and drove them into the Red Sea. There remained not one locust in all the borders of Egypt.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, Israel suante apaisak nuam tuan kei hi.
english: But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam tung a khomial, theihtheih ding khop mial sah a- omtheihna ding in, van lam ah na khut liktou in," achi hi.
heading: Mialna
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”

paite: Mosi in van lam ah akhut aliktou a; huchi in ni thum ah khomial sung Aigupta gam m tengteng bikbek a-omta hi.
english: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.

paite: Kuamah akimutuah kei ua, a-omna ua pan kuamah ni thum sung athoukhe kei uh; himahleh Israel suante tenna ah khua avak hi.
english: They didn’t see one another, and nobody rose from his place for three days; but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

paite: Pharaoh in Mosi asam a, "Pai un, TOUPA nna sem un. Na bawnghonte leh na ganhonte uh kia om uhen. Na nau neute un leng hon zui uhen," achi hi.
english: Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, “Go, serve Yahweh. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind. Let your little ones also go with you.”

paite: Himahleh Mosi in, “TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang a ka kithoihtheihna ding un, kithoihnate leh halmang thillatte leng na hon piak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Moses said, “You must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh our God.

paite: Ka bawnghonte un leng ahon zuih ding uh ahi. Nunglam ah khechin khat lel leng nutsiat ahi kei ding; huaite a pan TOUPA ka Pathian uh nna sepna dia ka lak ding uh ahih ziak in. Huai mun ka tun masiah uh, bang in ahia TOUPA nna ka sep ding uh, ka thei kei uh," achi hi.
english: Our livestock also shall go with us. Not a hoof shall be left behind, for of it we must take to serve Yahweh our God; and we don’t know with what we must serve Yahweh, until we come there.”

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, amau apaisak nuam kei.
english: But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he wouldn’t let them go.

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh in akiang ah, "Ka kiang a pan paimang in. Ka mel mu nawn lou ding in pilvang in, ka mel na muh nini a si ding lah na hih ngal a," achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said to him, “Get away from me! Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!”

paite: Mosi in, "Na gen bang in, na mel ka mu nawn kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Moses said, “You have spoken well. I will see your face again no more.”
